description: Two voltage-controlled amplifiers in one module, each with a fader and two control inputs

params.text: Attenuates that channel by hand, from silence to unity gain

inputs.text: Controls the gain of that channel exponentially, so the level changes faster near the top of the range
Controls the gain of that channel in proportion to the voltage, 0% at 0V rising to 100% at 10V
The signal to be amplified on that channel

outputs.text: That channel's signal after its fader and control inputs
